text:
Asha (AE): kicking off Pioneer Inc POC thread — proposed 4-week scope, focused on summarization + retrieval-augmented QA. want to align success criteria, security asks, and pricing expectations. pinging SE + security + CSM.
Luis (SE): thanks — quick ask list: 1) expected qps and avg doc size 2) example prompts / golden answers for eval set 3) whether Pioneer needs private deployment (VPC) or hosted API for trial.
Jamie (Customer): FYI we have ~200k docs, typical query hits ~2–3 docs, target latency <300ms for first token, monthly pilot traffic ~= 50k requests. Hosted is fine for now but want to understand encryption + IP allowlist.
Taylor (Security): noted. we'll need their SOC2 report or vendor questionnaire answers. also: do they require bring-your-own-key (BYOK)? if yes, that pushes to Dedicated/Private.
Kai (CSM): timeline idea — week 0: infra + data ingest, week 1: baseline runs + prompt iteration, week 2: evals & threshold tuning, week 3: canary with their app, week 4: wrap + recommendation. sound good? :calendar:
Luis (SE): for evals, suggest a 200-example gold set across intents. metrics: exact match / F1 for extraction, relevance P@1 for RAG, and a human-grade satisfaction check on 50 queries. goal: >=85% relevance and median latency <250ms.
Jamie (Customer): we can provide 250 gold items and 2 prompt variants per intent. also will need a quote for 4-week pilot (est. tokens + infra).
Asha (AE): I'll draft a pilot quote. quick pricing note: hosted pilot estimate will include token usage + reserved ephemeral capacity for stress tests — I'll share numbers by EOD.
Taylor (Security): outstanding security blockers: 1) inbound/outbound egress policy 2) KMS integration 3) audit log retention. Jamie, can your IR/security team fill vendor questionnaire? I can send our security packet.
Jamie (Customer): yes send the packet. BYOK not required for pilot, but audit logs and IP allowlist required.
Luis (SE): technical checklist for data ingest: please provide sample doc JSON (id, text, metadata), and S3 access or file upload endpoint. sample ingestion curl:
```bash
curl -X POST https://ingest.redwood.ai/upload \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -F "file=@pioneer_sample.ndjson"
```
Luis (SE): also, will run a quick prompt sweep using model variants (redwood/ggml-*-q4 and a fp16 candidate) and share latency/cost per-1k tokens.
Asha (AE): next steps / owners: 
- Asha: send pilot quote + contract draft (today)
- Luis: ingestion guide + eval harness, run baseline (tomorrow)
- Taylor: security packet + questionnaire (today)
- Jamie: provide gold set + sample docs + security contact (by Thu)
- Kai: schedule weekly check-ins and final demo (invite sent)
ops-bot: deploy job `pilot-pioneer-ingest` queued by Luis — status: pending
Luis (SE): one more thing — for success gating, agree we rollback to smaller model if latency/regressions occur? propose automatic fallback to smaller quantized variant on latency spike. thoughts?
Jamie (Customer): yes happy with automatic fallback as long as we capture quality deltas in logs.
Kai (CSM): copy. I'll add a dashboard for model variant comparisons and an alert for quality regressions.
Asha (AE): perfect. I'll follow up with quote + calendar invite. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
